claims.title: Amex, Network expand merchant acceptance across the UAE
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Network International's own release (network.ae) returned 403; AEME is the Amex Middle East licensee.

claims.claim: Network International is described as the first fintech to work with Amex Middle East on expanding in-store and online acceptance, with single-statement, single-settlement onboarding for merchants.
claims.quote: Network the first fintech company to work with American Express Middle East on its approach to expanding in-store and online acceptance
claims.title: Amex, Network expand merchant acceptance across the UAE
claims.label: Reported

claims.claim: 2026-07-21: Bottomline and Amex integrated Paymode into Amex Buyer Initiated Payments via 'BIP Connect', giving BIP customers access to Paymode's Premium ACH vendor network.
claims.quote: Bottomline and American Express are partnering to integrate Paymode into American Express Buyer Initiated Payments (BIP) through a new feature called BIP Connect.
claims.title: Bottomline and American Express Partner to Expand B2B Payment Connectivity Through Paymode
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Partner's press release; quotes Widad Chaoui, SVP and GM, Corporate and B2B Products, Amex.

claims.claim: 2026-07-21: Amex claimed the lowest U.S. credit card fraud rate among major card networks for the 19th consecutive year, attributing it to closed-loop visibility and AI models.
claims.quote: For 19 consecutive years, Amex has maintained the lowest U.S. fraud rate among major card networks
claims.title: For the 19th Year in a Row, American Express Has the Lowest U.S. Credit Card Fraud Rate Among Major Card Networks
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Source of the ranking (footnote 1) not visible in the text read; Nilson Report is the usual source.

claims.claim: 2026-04-24 and 2026-08-10: Amex opened Resy's restaurant inventory to AI assistants, first in Anthropic's Claude and then with in-chat booking in ChatGPT, as new demand channels for restaurant partners.
claims.quote: Resy today announced the launch of Resy reservation availability and booking in ChatGPT
claims.title: Resy Partners with OpenAI to Launch Resy Reservations in ChatGPT
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Claude integration (2026-04-24): 'Claude users can now explore U.S. Resy restaurants directly in their conversations when deciding where to eat.' at https://www.americanexpress.com/en-us/newsroom/articles/travel-and-dining/american-express-partners-with-anthropic-to-make-u-s--resy-resta.html

claims.claim: 2026-08-12: Resy completed the absorption of Tock venues, giving restaurants and wineries one Amex-owned booking platform of 25,000+ venues.
claims.quote: Starting today, diners can access over 25,000 venues on Resy with the addition of Tock's restaurants, wineries and experiences.
claims.title: Resy Welcomes Tock Restaurants, Wineries and Experiences to Its Platform and App, Expanding Access to More Than 25,000 Venues
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Quotes Pablo Rivero, CEO of Resy and SVP, American Express Global Dining.

claims.claim: 2026-08-13: Amex extended virtual-card issuance into its @ Work corporate platform and, for Business Travel Account customers, into Conferma's virtual-payments solutions.
claims.quote: Amex Corporate customers can now create, manage and use Amex Virtual Cards in Amex's software platform, @ Work
claims.title: American Express Expands Virtual Card Capabilities to Help Businesses Utilize Fast-Growing Commercial Payment Method
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Footnote markers removed from the quote. Quotes Eva Reda, EVP, Global Commercial Services Products.

claims.claim: 2026-08-20: Amex signed KBank, Krungsri and Siam Commercial Bank as acquiring partners to expand acceptance in Thailand, announced by Usman Arif, SVP Global Network Services APAC.
claims.quote: new partnerships with KASIKORNBANK (KBank), Bank of Ayudhya Public Company Limited (Krungsri) and Siam Commercial Bank (SCB) to expand Card acceptance in Thailand
claims.title: American Express Expands Card Acceptance in Thailand Through New Partnerships with Local Banks
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Network-partner (acquirer) signings; scale of locations not stated in the text read.

claims.claim: As of September 2026 Amex's executive committee page lists Anna Marrs as head of Global Merchant & Network Services and Glenda McNeal as Chief Partner Officer; no President, GNS sits on the committee.
claims.quote: Group President, Global Merchant & Network Services
claims.title: Executive Committee & Directors
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Also lists Mohammed Badi as President, Global Servicing and Ravi Radhakrishnan as CIO.

claims.claim: Outages: no press-reported Amex network outage affecting merchants or partners was found for the window; a third-party monitor logged a 52-minute account-display incident on 2026-02-09.
claims.quote: StatusGator last detected an outage on February 9, 2026.
claims.title: American Express Status | StatusGator
claims.label: Reported
claims.note: Crowd/signal-based monitor, not an Amex status page; incident described as 'Account balances and transactions not displaying or processing'.
